run_observations_fixer: run the observations_fixer function on a BMGraphBuilder to fix observation type violations and report impossible observations
review_observations_fixer: review the observations_fixer function to understand how it coerces observation values to match sample types
test_observations_fixer: test the observations_fixer function with a BMGraphBuilder containing Boolean, Natural, and Real observations
refactor_observations_fixer: refactor the observations_fixer function to handle matrix-valued samples and inconsistent observations of the same sample
summarize_observations_fixer: summarize the observations_fixer function which fixes BMG type system violations in observation nodes and reports impossible observations
